create_escape_task: create an Escape task with a CMUHumanoid walker and bowl-shaped arena for locomotion training
initialize_escape_episode: initialize an escape episode by spawning the walker at a random non-contacting height
compute_escape_reward: compute the escape reward based on walker distance from origin and upright posture
find_non_contacting_height: find a safe spawn height for the walker by incrementing z until no physics contacts exist
compute_upright_reward: compute an upright reward proportional to how aligned the walker torso is with the global z-axis
